note.zh: 隐藏事件 ancrel.4120（on_fleet_destroyed_perp）在龙国舰队被毁时按击杀者类型分发：默认国家→ 4020 给击杀者誊录仪，并通知其他事件链持有者 4121；非默认国家（如堕落帝国）→ 4122（项目“夏尔德遗骸”）。
note.en: Hidden ancrel.4120 (on_fleet_destroyed_perp) dispatches when the dragon's fleet is destroyed: a default-type killer gets 4020 (the Rubricator) and other chain owners get 4121; a non-default killer (e.g. a Fallen Empire) gives chain owners 4122 (project Shard's Remains).

note.en: "Restore the Shard" is enabled by the necromancer option of 4020 (a dragon fleet of our own, ancrel.4026); "Shard's Remains" is enabled by 4122 and 4123 grants minerals, rare crystals and the relic.
